summary.text: Norm Orrall is a Republican state representative from the 12th Bristol District who has held the seat since January 2, 2019 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Norman Orrall succeeded Keiko Orrall in the 12th Bristol District seat in January 2019.

In the 2025-2026 session his committee assignments include the House Ethics Committee, the Municipalities and Regional Government Joint Committee and the Transportation Joint Committee, and he is the ranking minority member of the Joint Committee on Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets.
